content:
OK, this is my first time truly being upset with this game.  I used to be able to get about 20 or so refined gnosis fragments per DTide, and now it seems I cannot get any.
Why this is a problem:
To get more refined gnosis fragments, I need to do better in DTide.
To do better in DTide, I need more refined gnosis fragments.

This is essentially locking out content.  Could someone please explain to me who thought it was a good idea to utterly lock out character growth.  These fragments were already hard enough to come by, and now they are close to impossible unless you already had them.  And that is the major problem; To get them, you need to have already had them, and if you already had them, you don't even really need to get them.

I am actually quite upset about this.

Like, this is actually a game breaking decision, and for a game that I loved so much up until this point, it is quite heartbreaking.
I mean, you have to understand that this basically completely kills the game.  No matter how good the characters pulled may be, if they cannot be leveled up, they will not be good enough.  I am sitting here literally jaw agape at this decision.  
After hours spent trying my hardest to pull out my typical 400 or so DTide points, to see that I get nothing that I can use to level up my characters is, well jaw dropping.  The bonus silver feels pointless if I can't level up characters.
Now the only place I can get these things is in the shop at absurdly high prices.
I hate to say it, but if this doesn't get fixed, I don't see myself playing the game much longer, not so much by choice, but there is just no point.  I am locked out of growth.
